title: The Perita Rebellion/Quotes
kind: 場所・ミッション・その他

lines: Voice lines heard during The Perita Rebellion.
- Lotus: "The Indifference lurks where you dare not look - the hidden past. Relive your battles on Tau and banish the ghosts that haunt you. The Hunhullus awaits."
- Lotus: "Reclaim your memories from the Indifference. You have only twelve minutes to confront your past battles. After that... the truth must be faced."
- Lotus: "Tenno, defy the Indifference and awaken your memories of the Perita Rebellion. You have only 12 minutes before the memory of the Hunhullus itself will arise to drag you under."
- Lotus: "You must confront the echo of The Hunhullus and what was done. There is no turning back now."
- Lotus: "You are out of time. The Hunhullus has found you."
- Lotus: "The dread of Tau takes shape. The Hunhullus is upon you. Your courage must not fail now."
- Lotus: "Your past is once again your own. Bravely done, Tenno. Rest now."
- Lotus: "You have won back your memories from the Void's corruption. Chaos has lost this battle."
- Lotus: "You fought with honor, then and now. Well done, my child."
- Lotus: "On Perita you fought alongside the Sentients, but some were forced to be enemies. Relive those memories and reclaim them. After twelve minutes, memory becomes nightmare."
- Lotus: "The buried past must be brought to light, and we have little time. Return to the days of the Perita Rebellion, when the Dax Anarchs turned former Sentient allies against you."
- Lotus: "I must send you back into a war you barely survived. Remember the battles you were forced to fight, however bitter the memory. Everything depends upon it."
- Lotus: "The wise, kind Dactolysts were twisted into horrors. We owe it to them to remember what was done."
- Lotus: "The Dactolyst. A memory of how something pure was mercilessly tainted."
- Lotus: "I know what it is like to have your very mind deformed and broken. This Dactolyst stands for all its kind."
- Lotus: "In recovering these memories you have restored dignity to the dead and protected your past from corruption. Excellent work."
- Lotus: "It is vital to remember the war as it truly was. You have done admirably, Tenno."
- Lotus: "All our people were betrayed in the Old War. The more we remember, the better our chance of a new peace."

- Lotus: "Your memories were erased out of mercy, but if they are not recovered the Indifference will corrupt them. Descend into the hell that was the Perita Rebellion, and remember how even Warframes were turned against you."
- Lotus: "Teshin began the recovery of your past. Now you must go further, no matter the cost. Remembering will be dangerous, but forgetting risks the loss of everything."
- Lotus: "Dive deep, Tenno. Remember the peace that was sabotaged by greed and pride. Relive the tragedy you were forced to endure."
- Lotus: "You have reached the nightmares below the surface. You must remember how you were forced to fight commandeered Prime Warframes."
- Lotus: "When the Prime Vanguard attacked, it felt like betrayal. You must go through that agony again."
- Lotus: "The Anarchs were cruel, turning loyal friends into maddened enemies. Lay their tormented ghosts to rest."
- Lotus: "Even with Prime Warframes turned upon you, you were victorious. Honor these memories."
- Lotus: "Well done, Tenno. Remember the fallen. Gather strength for the battles to come."
- Lotus: "The Indifference lies. It wants you to doubt yourself. But you have triumphed today."
- Valdur: "Anarch supply caches located. Get close and siphon them off for our side."
- Valdur: "Anarchs storing critical supplies nearby. Establish area control and siphon supplies."
- Valdur: "Marking critical Anarch supply caches. Make them ours."
- Adis: "Anarchs close, make gone, get cache."
- Adis: "Valdur, the Ten-no captures a cache."
- Adis: "Supplies captured. Battle-kin to be much relieved."
- Adis: "Anarchs take the death-foods. Not good."
- Adis: "Ten-no! Cache for we, not for them!"
- Adis: "Too late, Ten-no. Enemy get that one."
- Valdur: "That's the last of the caches. Got more orders for you."
- Valdur: "Caches captured. Marking your next target."
- Valdur: [laughs] "The only people who needed those supplies more than us were the Anarchs. They won't be happy. Let's pour salt in the wound."
- Valdur: "Mines! We're getting slaughtered on the advance. Destroy 'em, or if you're careful, hack 'em to neutralize the whole minefield more quickly."
- Valdur: "Minefield just tore up an entire regiment. Get in close and hack 'em to neutralize the field quickly or just blow them up one by one. Don't matter to me."
- Valdur: "I've got an infirmary full of wounded thanks to this minefield. We're stuck until those mines are exploded or hacked. Understood?"
- Valdur: "Mine field cleared. You saved lives today, Tenno. Keep going."
- Valdur: "Mines neutralized. You got nerves of steel, Tenno. I'll give you that."
- Valdur: "Dax used to deal with minefields by sending Grineer in. Disposable, you see. Next objective."
- Valdur: "We're pinned down. Anarch guns are hammering our rear echelon. Corrupt their targeting array, and then scrap the nodes."
- Valdur: "Got an Anarch targeting array lining up shots for their big guns. Your job: disable, then destroy."
- Valdur: "We can't mass assault troops because of Anarch pinpoint strikes. Need you to take out their targeting array and give our guys a fighting chance."
- Adis: "Progress stops. New access codes needed. You find?"
- Adis: "Node control interrupted. Must find new Anarch codes."
- Adis: "Stalled. New code needed. Find please."
- Adis: "Node scrambled. Guns quiet. Make scrap now? Find new codes."
- Adis: "Corruption complete. Anarch targeting impossible now. Use authorization? Make permanent?"
- Adis: "Node is useless, for now. Time to initiate meltdown protocol?"
- Valdur: "Targeting array scrapped. Our troops are already on the move. Your work's not done though, get in position."
- Valdur: "Array dismantled. They're shooting blind. Push forward."
- Valdur: "They've predicted our every move, and now we know why: ground scanners. Find them and scrap them."
- Valdur: "Find and destroy their ground scanners everywhere. Can't take a crap out here without some Dax Anarch taking pot shots."
- Valdur: "Anarchs have buried ground scanners everywhere. We're totally exposed until you dig them up and neutralize them."
- Adis: "Lose signal. Much interference, much Anarchs."
- Valdur: "Ground scanners eliminated. We can maneuver in peace again."
- Valdur: "Their intel systems have gone dark. Take the move forward."
- Valdur: "Well done. Those nosey bastards are about to get a nasty surprise. Move."
- Valdur: "Attention! Got an Anarch transport moving in. Do not let it reinforce the enemy."
- Valdur: "Transport incoming. Scrap it. No relief for the enemy."
- Valdur: "Transport full of weapons and ammo is enroute to enemy positions. Intercept and destroy. Go."
- Adis: "Ten-no! Repair pads! Destroy! Or transport never explode."
- Adis: "Repair pads. All over place. Must stop or else."
- Valdur: "Transport is scrap. There will be no relief for the Anarchs today. Now make it count. Next objective."
- Valdur: "You've cut off supply lines. Anarchs are hurting now. Seize this opportunity and push forward."
- Valdur: "Aww. What a shame. No dinner for the Dax Anarchs. Here's your new orders..."
- Valdur: "Anarchs have captured a Makvos cannon and it's hitting us hard. Take it down."
- Valdur: "Anarchs captured a Makvos cannon and now it's shredding our rear echelon. Silence that gun."
- Valdur: "Hear that Makvos cannon? We're all mincemeat unless you can take it out."
- Adis: "Armor too strong. Find codes, talk to vents, expose munitions, boom."
- Adis: "Find codemaster. Expose munitions. Explode munitions?"
- Adis: "Expose munitions with codes? Which Anarch is codemaster?"
- Adis: "Munitions vent exposed. Bad for Anarch, good for we."
- Adis: "Makvos cannon on brink. Job finish."
- Valdur: [short laugh] "You never cease to amaze me, Tenno."
- Valdur: "The silence is beautiful. Now push forward."
- Valdur: "Makvos down, and not a second too soon. Press the initiative."

path: Draw out the Commandeered Prime Warframe
lines: - Valdur: "They're hammering us hard. We need to strike back. There's a commandeered Prime in the area. Do what it takes to draw them out."
- Valdur: "Commandeered Prime Warframes are the strongest weapons the Anarchs have. Fight fire with fire and draw one out."
- Valdur: "Ops has identified one of Galastra's commandeered Primes. Draw them out, and neutralize them."
- Valdur: "They're out. Put them out of their misery."
- Valdur: "Here it comes. Put them in the ground."
- Valdur: "We wanted peace. The Anarchs chose death. Keep fighting, we have to finish the job."
- Valdur: "It's done. I know that wasn't pleasant, but it was necessary."
- Valdur: "Reinforcements! Where in Sol's sky did they come from? Tenno... take them out!"
- Valdur: "Dropships! Give those Sol-damned bastards hell."
- Valdur: "More coming! Take out assault squad! In the air or the ground. Doesn't matter to me."
- Adis: "Ten-no, Anarchs fall from air like bloom-seeds!"
- Valdur: "Dropships and their crews neutralized. But we're not out of the woods yet."
- Valdur: "They'll think before trying that maneuver again. Let's find a new way to punish these Anarchs."
- Valdur: "Good luck replacing those. Use this opening, move forward."
- Valdur: "This is a rout. Thin the Anarch ranks."
- Valdur: "Now is the time. Punish the Anarchs and take out as many as you can."
- Valdur: "Make the Anarchs regret their disloyalty. Cut them down."
- Adis: "Blink pads charge. More Anarchs come."
- Valdur: "Every time you grind those bastards into the mud and I feel a little twinge of pity, I remember what they did to my brothers."
- Valdur: "Boot's on the other foot now, isn't it, Galastra? Break off from this fight, Tenno. Your blade is needed elsewhere."
- Valdur: "Anarch pride was their death sentence. If only they had listened. Keep moving."
- Valdur: "Got a squad of Brachs destined for core override. We can't afford that. Find them and break them out."
- Valdur: "Anarch bastards have captured some of our Brachiolyst comrades. Need you to set 'em free before they give 'em a core override."
- Adis: "Ten-no! Hive-kin stolen. Save before hive-kin cores changed to Anarch mind."
- Adis: "Hive-kin in trouble. Must stop captor. Return kin to hive."
- Adis: "Hive-kin, you are free. Follow Ten-no."
- Valdur: "Don't let a scratch get on those Brachs, we need them."
- Valdur: "We need those Brachs badly. Well done."
- Valdur: "Glad we still have those Brachs on our side. Good job, Tenno."
- Adis: "Ten-no, help needed. Hive-kin taken. Bring home."
- Adis: "Anarchs stole hive-kin. Put in cage. Tenno do right thing."
- Valdur: "Anarchs have captured a Sentient scout. Get him out of there before they can convert him."
- Valdur: "One of our scouts just got captured. I don't need to tell you what the anarchs are capable of. Get them out of there."
- Adis: "Hive-kin go clear! Ten-no is friend."
- Adis: "Ten-no make hive-kin safe for certain."
- Valdur: "Scout just gave us critical intel but we've got to move fast."
- Valdur: "Thanks to Sol you got that scout back safe. We've got exactly what we need to make our next move, go."
- Valdur: "Sentient scout is safe and recovering. You, on the other hand, need to get back out into the field. Go."
- Valdur: "Anarchs! We're under attack! Hold the line!"
- Valdur: "They're storming our position. Hold the line!"
- Valdur: "It's a raid! Shut it down! Repel the anarchs!"
- Valdur: "They've broken through. You need to stop them."
- Valdur: "You've repelled them. Now make them pay."
- Valdur: "You've turned the tide. But you're not done."
- Valdur: "Die in the dirt, anarch scum! Now's our chance..."
- Valdur: "Your objective is an Anarch shuttle. Hack in an uplink and Adis can fly it home."
- Valdur: "Supply shuttles up ahead, chock full of key resources. Install an uplink and keep it safe until Adis can get it airborne remotely."
- Valdur: "Command needs a functional Anarch shuttle. Why? None of our Sol-damned business. We just need to get one into Orokin territory in one piece."
- Adis: "Systems online. Engines start slow. Keep safe."
- Adis: "Adis is pilot now. Engines warming."
- Valdur: "That shuttle is ours and so is its cargo."
- Valdur: "The shuttle is safe. Flight logs indicate Anarch targets near your location. Get moving."
- Valdur: "We've got the shuttle and its cargo. Ready for another fight?"
- Valdur: "We've captured their tight-beam transmitter, and troves of intel with it. Seize battery parts from the enemy, and juice that thing to the max to send the signal back to HQ."
- Valdur: "Anarch tight-beam transmitter is under our control. Get it powered and we'll send their secrets right back to HQ."
- Valdur: "Got critical intel loaded onto a tight-beam transmitter but it's gone dark. Find a way to power it to max."
- Adis: "Battery assembled. Transmitter hungry for power."
- Adis: "Ten-no made battery. Power transmitter now?"
- Adis: "Battery crude, but work still. Put in transmitter."
- Adis: "Anarch weapons outfit include cathode and anode. Battery make?"
- Adis: "Adis detect cathode and anode parts on Anarchs. Ten-no use!"
- Adis: "Fifty-percent power, do not stop now."
- Adis: "We are so close, get more power."
- Valdur: "Data-transfer initiated. Well look at this, Tenno. Got new orders for you."
- Valdur: "We have uplink! This changes everything. Get to the next rendezvous point."
- Valdur: "Boom. Uplink successful. Can't let this data go to waste, marking next objective."
- Valdur: "Turrets running low. Ammo air-drops incoming. Keep the area clear."
- Valdur: "Got air-drops inbound to resupply those turrets. Establish a permitter and keep those Sol-damned Anarchs out."
- Valdur: "Our turrets desperately need resupply. Ammo air-drop enroute. Keep the drop zone clear."
- Adis: "Drop zone too hot. Clear you must."
- Valdur: "All turrets firing, and not a moment too soon. I've got more work for you."
- Valdur: "You're a life-line Tenno. Hope you got another miracle in you."
- Valdur: "Those turrets are back in fighting shape. No time to rest, you're needed elsewhere."
- Adis: "Hive-kin in trouble. Needs help. Needs Energy Core. You help, Adis knows."
- Adis: "Ten-no must help hive-kin. Anarchs attack, energy low. You must save."
- Adis: "Valdur! Adis need Ten-no! Hive-kin under attack. Anarchs drain energy. Death near. Help kin now!"
- Adis: "Energy is aid. Bring to hive-kin."
- Adis: "Hurry, Tenno! Hive-kin needs energy-core for live."
- Adis: "Kin breathes hive-life. Lives to fight."
- Adis: "Hive-kin safe. Hive-kin thank Ten-no. Tenno back to orders now."
- Adis: "Tenno friend saves hive-kin friend. Valdur has new orders."
- Adis: "Friend needed for fight. Ten-no help all hive-kin."
- Galastra: "Enough! Let Ballas's nightmares face their own kind!"
- Galastra: "Those Warframes are all that make you special. See how you fare against one!"
- Galastra: "Deploy a Warframe. A commandeered Prime or one of the insane ones, I don't care."
- Galastra: "Would you care to face one of your former friends, Tenno?"
- Galastra: "Look what my Ascaris did to one of your Warframes. What happened to its Operator can happen to you, too."
- Galastra: "You fawning fools think you're the only ones with Warframes. Allow me to educate you."
- Galastra: "I want fire, I want fury. Let a Warframe take the field."
- Galastra: "I've waited long enough. Let a Prime Warframe loose."
- Galastra: "Your Warframes cut down my comrades like cattle. See how it feels."
- Galastra: "We shed our blood for this land. We will not hand it over to the machines."
- Galastra: "When peace means spitting on the bodies of our dead, then there can be no peace."
- Galastra: "Did they tell you there was 'honor' in cutting down the bravest of the Dax?"
- Galastra: "Oh, it's easy to be brave from inside your miraculous Warframes, isn't it?"
- Galastra: "You Tenno whelps have no idea how many of the Orokin support us in secret."
- Galastra: "You're too stupid to realise the machines are playing you for fools."
- Galastra: "The machines turned on you once. You're insane if you think they wouldn't do it again."
- Galastra: "Look at the faces of the Dax you slaughtered, Tenno. Maybe you'll recognize some former comrades."
- Galastra: "You're fighting for your golden masters. We're fighting for a home."
- Galastra: "History will remember you as the twisted killers you were."
